text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The Hopeful Stakes is one of the major
races for
determining who will become
the junior year
champion.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I will use this G1 race to rise to even
greater
heights.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You know what that means, right,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Correct. In other words, I will put on my
best and
most beautiful display yet.
choice_data_list_en: This is merely a stepping stone.
